name: VertiMonial
author: Haseeb Abid

sections.description:
VertiMonial is a lightweight, SEO-friendly, and easy-to-use WordPress plugin that helps you display testimonials in a vertical scrolling slider format.

Designed with performance in mind, VertiMonial allows you to manage testimonials (client feedback, reviews, or quotes) from your admin panel and showcase them using a simple shortcode. Each testimonial includes the person’s name, designation/role, image, and message. Ideal for portfolios, agencies, freelancers, and businesses that want to build trust.

Key Features:
– Vertical auto-scrolling slider
– Backend testimonial management
– Add title (name), content, image, and role/designation
– Clean and responsive layout
– Lightweight and fast performance
– Easy shortcode integration: [vertim_testimonials_slider]

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory. (Make sure folder name is vertimonial)
  2. Activate the plugin via the WordPress “Plugins” menu.
  3. Navigate to VertiMonial in your WordPress admin dashboard.
  4. Add testimonials using “Add New”.
  5. Insert the shortcode [vertim_testimonials_slider] into any post, page, or widget area.
sections.faq:
🔹 How do I add a testimonial?

Go to VertiMonial > Add New, enter a name, testimonial content, featured image, and optionally a role or designation.

🔹 Can I customize the slider?

Yes, edit the CSS file at assets/css/slider.css for styling. For advanced functionality, developer assistance is recommended.

🔹 Does it work with all themes?

Yes, VertiMonial is built to be theme-agnostic and works with most modern WordPress themes.

🔹 Is it translation ready?

Yes, the plugin is prepared for localization using the vertimonial text domain.
